ruleset.name: Contrast MCP PMD Rules
ruleset.description: Static-analysis rules shared by main and test sources. Main sources add production-only rules from main-ruleset.xml.

rule.name: AvoidRawMockitoAny
rule.message: Use a typed Mockito matcher instead of raw any().
rule.description: Raw Mockito any() matchers hide type expectations in tests.

rule.name: AvoidInlineLoggingKeyLiteral
rule.message: Declare logging keys in LoggingKeys instead of inline literals.
rule.description: Structured log key names must be constants defined in LoggingKeys.

rule.name: PreferLombokNoArgsConstructor
rule.message: Use @NoArgsConstructor(access = AccessLevel.PRIVATE) instead of a hand-written private constructor.
rule.description: Utility classes should use Lombok for private constructor boilerplate.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: FluentLogInCatchRequiresCause
rule.message: SLF4J fluent logging inside catch blocks must call setCause(exception).
rule.description: log.at*().log() in a catch block drops the stack trace unless setCause is present.
